sections.heading: Type power
lines: Mud Bomb, Mud Shot, and Mud-Slap also count as Poison for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Mud Bomb, Mud Shot, Mud-Slap, Power Whip, and Vine Whip: 1.5× stronger.
Gunk Shot, Octazooka, Sludge, Sludge Bomb, and Sludge Wave: 1.2× stronger.
Bulldoze, Earthquake, and Magnitude: weakened to 0.25×.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Poison-type.
Secret Power can cause burn, freezing, paralysis, or poison.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Tidy Up breaks the field apart once their uses add up to 3 (Tidy Up 1), exposing whatever lay beneath it.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Entry hazards (Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes) are suspended while this field lasts.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Telluric Seed: Attack +1, Special Attack +1, and scatters Stealth Rock on both sides.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
